title: Robot creators
content: This robot was created by students of the CSE Graduating batch of 2026, the students are: Aiman Shariff, Juniad Pasha, Bhargav and Mukesh Umesh under the guidance of Dr.Nithin Kumar. This version of the robot is an early prototype.

title: Robot info
keywords: what is this robot created for
content: This robot was created by VVCE Students in 2026 as a final year project and to help the college in making the campus digitally smarter by helping out as a campus assistant by answering common questions from visitots, students and staff. This is an early prototype to ultimately meet this goal.
